title: Camera quality, bigger dither, overlay-in-photo option
description: Let the user pick how good the camera is (samples per line, from a toy cam to sharp 640), dither at up to 640x480 with more palettes and a brightness knob, and choose whether the REC/date overlay is burned into photos and videos.

clauses.text: The quality setting picks how many samples each line has (160 toy cam up to 640 sharp), always at 480 lines (640 upright) and a 4:3 picture, and higher quality really keeps finer detail.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "quality sets samples per line and keeps detail" passes

clauses.text: Dither goes up to 640x480 pixels, offers at least 18 colour choices including C64 and ZX Spectrum, and has a brightness knob that changes the result.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "dither goes bigger with more palettes and brightness" passes

clauses.text: When the user turns 'REC & date in photos' on, the photo is exactly the filtered viewfinder picture, overlay included; when off, it has none.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "overlay can be kept in photos" passes

cases.description: each Quality gives width = samples (x3/4 upright), 480/640 lines, 4:3/3:4 display; a fine stripe pattern keeps more contrast at 640 than at 240
pixel knob reaches 640x480 and 480x360; >= 18 palettes incl. a 16-colour C64 and 15-colour ZX Spectrum; brightness 0 vs 1 differ
keepOverlay=true: photo equals viewfinder frame pixel for pixel; keepOverlay=false: photo equals the overlay-free render
